title: MemoryArena: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Interdependent Multi-Session Agentic Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2602.16313v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing evaluations of agents with memory typically assess memorization and action in isolation. One class of benchmarks evaluates memorization by testing recall of past conversations or text but fails to capture how memory is used to guide future decisions. Another class focuses on agents acting in single-session tasks without the need for long-term memory. However, in realistic settings, memorization and action are tightly coupled: agents acquire memory while interacting with the environment, and subsequently rely on that memory to solve future tasks. translated_title: MemoryArena：在相互依赖的多会话智能体任务中对智能体记忆进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 现有针对具有记忆能力的智能体的评估通常将记忆与行动割裂开来。一类基准通过测试对过去对话或文本的回忆来评估记忆能力，但未能捕捉记忆如何被用于指导未来决策；另一类基准则聚焦于智能体在单会话任务中的行动，无需长期记忆。然而，在现实场景中，记忆与行动是紧密耦合的：智能体在与环境交互的过程中获取记忆，随后依赖这些记忆来解决未来的任务。为了刻画这一场景，我们提出了MemoryArena，这是一个统一的评估平台，用于在多会话的记忆-智能体-环境循环中对智能体记忆进行基准测试。该基准由人工设计的智能体任务构成，这些任务包含明确相互依赖的子任务，智能体必须从早期的行动和反馈中学习，将经验提炼到记忆中，并随后利用这些记忆来指导后续行动。
tldr: 提出了MemoryArena——一个在多会话记忆-智能体-环境循环中评估智能体记忆的统一基准平台，通过明确相互依赖的子任务，考察智能体将经验提炼为记忆并用于指导未来决策的能力。
en_tdlr: MemoryArena is a unified evaluation gym that benchmarks agent memory in multi-session Memory-Agent-Environment loops, using explicitly interdependent subtasks to test how agents distill experiences into memory and leverage it to guide future decisions.
